title.narrative: Enhancing climate change adaptation and resilience in Kilifi and Tana River counties, Kenya

description.narrative: Overal Objective (Impact): 10.000 persons in Kilifi and Tana River Counties use their natural resources sustainably and peacefully to strengthen community resilience and adaptation to climate changeProject Objective (Outcome): Strengthened resilience and adaptation to climate change through sustainable, peaceful use of natural resources for 10,000 persons in Kilifi and Tana River Counties.
The direct beneficiaries of the project will be 10,000 persons (with at least 30% women and 20% youth) with an indirect reach of 50,000 people

The proposed project in Tana River and Kilifi. aims to mitigate against these effects by strengthening the community’s resilience and adaptation to climate change through sustainable, peaceful use of natural resources. This will include water resource management, strengthening economic development opportunities in Value chain development, increasing nutrition knowledge and utilization of local foods, peace building support county government on system strengthening. Target: 10,000 people, 2,000HH
